Question 1: "O Supremo Tribunal Federal deve se abster de legislar ou modificar leis existentes, limitando-se à interpretação da norma?" Question 2: "A ANEEL deve ser mais firme na fiscalização das concessionárias de energia elétrica?" This asks whether the energy regulator (ANEEL) should be stricter in supervising electricity concessionaires. It's about regulatory enforcement.

These are different institutions, different subjects. Not same question, not opposite polarity. So relation = DIFFERENT.
